title: KnowledgePersonCurrent
description: Whether the person is a current employee at this moment, as the control plane's HR record and Entra user link say. Anything but current is not current.

reason.description: Why not current: the token did not validate, the user is not linked to a current joiner (a leaver, or a person Muistamo has no HR record or link for), or the tenant's identity binding is changing.
